Config_1_Standard.name: Standard Feedback Loop (Default Baseline)
Config_1_Standard.description: Standard label-smoothed cross-entropy with moderate edge-erasing and mild affine rotation.

Config_2_High_Regularization.name: High Regularization & Conservative Calibration
Config_2_High_Regularization.description: High label smoothing (α=0.12) and elevated temperature scaling (T=1.35) to maximize entropy regularization and minimize ECE.

Config_3_Aggressive_Augmentation.name: Aggressive Structural Stress Augmentation
Config_3_Aggressive_Augmentation.description: Aggressive contour disruption with heavy erasing cutouts and extreme shear to force global shape invariance.

Config_4_Adaptive_Fragility_Weighted.name: Adaptive Fragility-Weighted Feedback
Config_4_Adaptive_Fragility_Weighted.description: Adaptive hard-variant curriculum: upweights fragile representations (Dotted, Dashed, Sketch, Silhouette) by 2.0x in training loss.
